name: Cinnamon-Bellows Bluff
core_rationale: Ninth warm terracotta spice-drying bluff of Continent 01 where Sola's aromatic hearth-drafts cure cinnamon-bark windbreaks above the western orchard rim.
local_conflict: Cinnamon-bark beetles and playful ember-tail foxes nest inside the warm spice-drying flues.

portal_edges.lock_reason: Swirling aromatic spice-drafts across Star-Anise Promontory require Mill-Steward Clove's Star-Pod Lantern.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Bakers in Lantern Hollow say the warm breezes from Cinnamon-Bellows Bluff smell of toasted cinnamon-sugar before every sunrise.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Terraced terracotta spice-towers with curling cinnamon-bark louvers along the western basin rim.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What star-anise wind-belfry crowns Star-Anise Promontory?

geography.biome: A breezy bluff on the western rim, with red-brown cinnamon-bark windbreaks and terraced spice towers; old forest begins at its back edge, with open grass between the trees and the towers.

weather.name: Spice-smoke breeze
weather.feel: A cinnamon-scented draft rises from the drying flues and leans east with the wind before sunrise.

weather.name: Bluff dew
weather.feel: Damp air leaves beads of dew on the bark louvers and the stone steps.

weather.name: Forest-edge wind
weather.feel: Wind runs through the old trees behind the bluff and the bark louvers creak.

geography.water: The Glaze River runs past the foot of the bluff as a narrow fast brook and falls south to the Ginger-Steam Terraces.
geography.far_landmark: The slender crown of Star-Anise Promontory above the bark-louvered spice towers, with the smell of toasted cinnamon on the wind, seen north-north-west from Ginger-Steam Terraces.
discovery_hooks: A louvered tower with no door, its flues still hot to the touch.
A fox den cut into a bark windbreak, with several ember-tail prints leading from it.

encounter_bands.source: ChatGPT 'World Structure Merge Proposal v1', 2026-11-18, section 3.2

gameplay.new_player: Tava Lv 1-10 prologue; gathering, forest exploration
gameplay.veteran_return: Rare herbs, memory-themed events, craft resources
gameplay.party_content: 2-4: grove expeditions; 1-5: Chapter II story dungeon
gameplay.cross_race_reason: Market festivals and the Tava Grove story

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-sola-hearth-weaver and scar-kiln-basin along the western spice-drying bluffs of Continent 01 and connects west to Saffron-Press Village.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Terraced terracotta spice-towers with curling cinnamon-bark louvers venting warm aromatic drafts.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Specifies 12.5m spice-viaduct roads, 0.58m spice-mill counters, and 0.14m terracotta risers tailored to 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: 2x2 connected matrix at [0,1], [1,1], [1,1] floor -1, and [1,0] with flora_fauna and carapace monster families.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Preserves hunting-area-star-anise-promontory in Mystery status behind a Fog of Lore portal with explicit lock_reason.
